summary:
Fluent Reader is an Electron RSS reader built with Fluent UI; here its renderer runs in a normal browser. I saved 5 views, and each one replayed with a similarity of 1.00:
1. all-articles-cards: the main workspace. A left menu lists the groups and sources with unread counts, next to the article feed in Cards layout.
2. magazine-view: the same feed in Magazine layout (View menu → Magazine view), a single column of articles with thumbnails and snippets.
3. settings-sources: the Sources tab in Settings, with OPML import/export, the add-source field and the table of subscriptions. One source is selected, so its edit form shows.
4. settings-rules-edit: the Rules tab with LWN.net as the target, editing the existing regex rule (search field, match condition, expression and action), plus the test-rules form.
5. settings-preferences: the app preferences, including language, theme, fetch interval, search engine, proxy, clean-up, cache and backup/restore.

What I couldn't capture: the article reader overlay opens with its header toolbar, but the body stays blank, because the article is shown in an Electron-only webview. That was still true after waiting and after turning on the "load full content" option, so I didn't save it. I also left out the List and Compact layouts as near-duplicates, and didn't explore the alerts log or the Groups and Service tabs.

One thing to know: the layout choice is remembered within a browser session. I switched back to Card view after saving the Magazine view. Each replay starts in a fresh browser, so the views aren't affected.
